# <span id="aanchor242"></span> Purge Source Analysis Data

Use the Source Analysis Purge screen to delete data from the database for sources in a list, or for individual sources.

This is a very powerful utility that should be used carefully. A lot of important data can be deleted easily, especially if you purge data using the "All Date/Time" option. For this reason, you can only access Source Analysis Purge if you have **Purge** \> **Source Analysis** privileges on at least one system.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Source Analysis Purge screen:

Go to **Tools** \> **Purge** \> **Source Analysis Data**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 433;height: 248;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Source Analysis Purge Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following options are available on the Source Analysis Purge screen:

- **Date Range** - Perform the purge for a date range or all date/time.
- **Keep Original Data** - Keep original data and only delete the edits. If you need to delete all data and re-import it, do not select this option.

</div>
